items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think it's Shockey's Cousins. They probably mainly used Shockey.

ctx.x: Around Millenberg, something like that. Around Millenberg, yeah, around Frenchman, like I said, religion field of Frenchman, around there. Yeah, right in there. Yeah, I played it there one time, I mean. They used to, people used to use it practically every Monday, for some sort of a banquet or something. Yeah. And Querellis, did you ever play that? No. No.
I think it's Shockey's Cousins. They probably mainly used Shockey. I don't know. And what about the trades? What kind of trades did people have down in the Ninth Ward?

Like, the different musicians, did they work days? Well, some of them worked in carpentry business, you know, and some... done some kind of work where they wasn't compelled to go to work every day. Mm-hmm. So, in case they had to stay out at night too late, they'd just be able to stay home.
